test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

**__Blunt__ **objects will not have that much impact.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Sharp."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"blunt"** means having a dull or rounded edge. ((चाक़ू आदि) )

 
 
• **Example**: *This knife is **blunt**__.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of** "blunt"** is **"sharp."**
 
• **"Sharp"** means having a thin edge or point that can cut or pierce. (तेज़ धार या नोंक वाला, धारदार या नोकदार; जो आसानी से किसी वस्‍तु को काट दे या उसमें छेद कर दे, पैना, तीक्ष्‍ण)
 __
 
• **Example**: *She has a **sharp**__ teeth.*
 
 

The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (Honest)** means (used about a person) telling the truth; not lying to people or stealing. ((व्‍यक्ति) सत्‍याचरण करने वाला, ईमानदार; चोरी आदि असत्‍याचरण न करने वाला)
 
• **Option 3 (Torrid) **means very hot and dry. (बहुत गरम या सूखा; उष्ण)
 
• **Option 4 (Lame) **means weak or unconvincing. ((प्रायः पशुओं के लिए प्रयुक्त) टाँग या पैर में चोट के कारण लँगड़ा)
